lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਘਟੈ ਮੂਲੁ ਨਿਤ ਬਢੈ ਬਿਆਜੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jih ghatai mool nit badhai biaaj || rahaau ||
lines.translation: It depletes my capital, and the interest charges only increase. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਤ ਸੂਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਨਜੁ ਕੀਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: saat soot mil banaj keen ||
lines.translation: Weaving the seven threads together, they carry on their trade.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਸੰਗ ਲੀਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam bhaavanee sa(n)g leen ||
lines.translation: They are led on by the karma of their past actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਜਗਾਤੀ ਕਰਤ ਰਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: teen jagaatee karat raar ||
lines.translation: The three tax-collectors argue with them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਲੋ ਬਨਜਾਰਾ ਹਾਥ ਝਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: chalo banajaaraa haath jhaar ||2||
lines.translation: The traders depart empty-handed. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਹਿਰਾਨੀ ਬਨਜੁ ਟੂਟ ॥
lines.transliteration: poo(n)jee hiraanee banaj toot ||
lines.translation: Their capital is exhausted, and their trade is ruined.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਟਾਂਡੋ ਗਇਓ ਫੂਟਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dah dis taa(n)do gaio phoot ||
lines.translation: The caravan is scattered in the ten directions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨ ਸਰਸੀ ਕਾਜ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer man sarasee kaaj ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, O mortal, your tasks will be accomplished,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਨੋ ਤ ਭਰਮ ਭਾਜ ॥੩॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj samaano ta bharam bhaaj ||3||6||
lines.translation: when you merge in the Celestial Lord; let your doubts run away. ||3||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲੁ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: basa(n)t hi(n)dol ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Basant Hindol, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤਾ ਜੂਠੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਭੀ ਜੂਠਾ ਜੂਠੇ ਹੀ ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maataa joothee pitaa bhee joothaa joothe hee phal laage ||
lines.translation: The mother is impure, and the father is impure. The fruit they produce is impure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹਿ ਜੂਠੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਭੀ ਜੂਠੇ ਜੂਠੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aavahi joothe jaahi bhee joothe joothe marahi abhaage ||1||
lines.translation: Impure they come, and impure they go. The unfortunate ones die in impurity. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸੂਚਾ ਕਵਨੁ ਠਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu pa(n)dit soochaa kavan thaau ||
lines.translation: Tell me, O Pandit, O religious scholar, which place is uncontaminated?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹਾਂ ਬੈਸਿ ਹਉ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jahaa(n) bais hau bhojan khaau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Where should I sit to eat my meal? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਬਾ ਜੂਠੀ ਬੋਲਤ ਜੂਠਾ ਕਰਨ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਜੂਠੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jihabaa joothee bolat joothaa karan netr sabh joothe ||
lines.translation: The tongue is impure, and its speech is impure. The eyes and ears are totally impure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕੀ ਜੂਠਿ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨਿ ਕੇ ਲੂਠੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: i(n)dree kee jooth utaras naahee braham agan ke loothe ||2||
lines.translation: The impurity of the sexual organs does not depart; the Brahmin is burnt by the fire. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਭੀ ਜੂਠੀ ਪਾਨੀ ਜੂਠਾ ਜੂਠੀ ਬੈਸਿ ਪਕਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: agan bhee joothee paanee joothaa joothee bais pakaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The fire is impure, and the water is impure. The place where you sit and cook is impure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੂਠੀ ਕਰਛੀ ਪਰੋਸਨ ਲਾਗਾ ਜੂਠੇ ਹੀ ਬੈਠਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: joothee karachhee parosan laagaa joothe hee baith khaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: Impure is the ladle which serves the food. Impure is the one who sits down to eat it. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਰੁ ਜੂਠਾ ਚਉਕਾ ਜੂਠਾ ਜੂਠੀ ਦੀਨੀ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gobar joothaa chaukaa joothaa joothee deenee kaaraa ||
lines.translation: Impure is the cow dung, and impure is the kitchen square. Impure are the lines that mark it off.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੇਈ ਨਰ ਸੂਚੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਪਰੀ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer teee nar sooche saachee paree bichaaraa ||4||1||7||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, they alone are pure, who have obtained pure understanding. ||4||1||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਾਨੰਦ ਜੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamaana(n)d jee ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Raamaanand Jee, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਤ ਜਾਈਐ ਰੇ ਘਰ ਲਾਗੋ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kat jaaeeai re ghar laago ra(n)g ||
lines.translation: Where should I go? My home is filled with bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਭਇਓ ਪੰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa chit na chalai man bhaio pa(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My consciousness does not go out wandering. My mind has become crippled. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਦਿਵਸ ਮਨ ਭਈ ਉਮੰਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek divas man bhaee uma(n)g ||
lines.translation: One day, a desire welled up in my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਸਿ ਚੰਦਨ ਚੋਆ ਬਹੁ ਸੁਗੰਧ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghas cha(n)dan choaa bahu suga(n)dh ||
lines.translation: I ground up sandalwood, along with several fragrant oils.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਨ ਚਾਲੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਠਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: poojan chaalee braham thaai ||
lines.translation: I went to God's place, and worshipped Him there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਤਾਇਓ ਗੁਰ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: so braham bataaio gur man hee maahi ||1||
lines.translation: That God showed me the Guru, within my own mind. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਹ ਜਲ ਪਖਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: jahaa jaaeeai tah jal pakhaan ||
lines.translation: Wherever I go, I find water and stones.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: too poor rahio hai sabh samaan ||
lines.translation: You are totally pervading and permeating in all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਭ ਦੇਖੇ ਜੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed puraan sabh dekhe joi ||
lines.translation: I have searched through all the Vedas and the Puraanas.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਹਾਂ ਤਉ ਜਾਈਐ ਜਉ ਈਹਾਂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: oohaa(n) tau jaaeeai jau eehaa(n) na hoi ||2||
lines.translation: I would go there, only if the Lord were not here. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤੋਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur mai balihaaree tor ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to You, O my True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਕਲ ਬਿਕਲ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਾਟੇ ਮੋਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin sakal bikal bhram kaate mor ||
lines.translation: You have cut through all my confusion and doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਾਨੰਦ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਮਤ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamaana(n)d suaamee ramat braham ||
lines.translation: Raamaanand's Lord and Master is the All-pervading Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰਮ ॥੩॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad kaatai kot karam ||3||1||
lines.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad eradicates the karma of millions of past actions. ||3||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: basa(n)t baanee naamadeu jee kee ||
lines.translation: Basant, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੰਕਟਵੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਭਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahib sa(n)katavai sevak bhajai ||
lines.translation: If the servant runs away when his master is in trouble,

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਨ ਜੀਵੈ ਦੋਊ ਕੁਲ ਲਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: chira(n)kaal na jeevai dooo kul lajai ||1||
lines.translation: he will not have a long life, and he brings shame to all his family. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਲੋਗੁ ਹਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: teree bhagat na chhodau bhaavai log hasai ||
lines.translation: I shall not abandon devotional worship of You, O Lord, even if the people laugh at me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਹੀਅਰੇ ਬਸੈਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal mere heeare basai(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Lotus Feet abide within my heart. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਧਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਮਰਨੁ ਮਾਂਡੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaise apane dhanahi praanee maran maa(n)dai ||
lines.translation: The mortal will even die for the sake of his wealth;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛਾਡੈਂ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: taise sa(n)t janaa(n) raam naam na chhaadai(n) ||2||
lines.translation: in the same way, the Saints do not forsake the Lord's Name. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੰਗਾ ਗਇਆ ਗੋਦਾਵਰੀ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੇ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ga(n)gaa gaiaa godaavaree sa(n)saar ke kaamaa ||
lines.translation: Pilgrimages to the Ganges, the Gaya and the Godawari are merely worldly affairs.
